items.problem: The bootstrap leaves the UWP sample's app root namespace (SDKTemplate) unchanged, so every copied .cs/.xaml keeps 'namespace SDKTemplate', 'x:Class="SDKTemplate.*"', and 'xmlns:local="using:SDKTemplate"', while the scaffold's App/MainWindow live in the project namespace (Personalization). The dev-agent had to hand-reconcile these across every file.
items.evidence: session-log.txt: bootstrap reports 'Rewrote Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml in 2 of 8 files' only (turn 2); 'namespace SDKTemplate' at log lines 489,530,656,744,898; x:Class="SDKTemplate.MainPage" (898) and xmlns:local="using:SDKTemplate" (901); manual rewrite edits at log lines 1409-1432.
items.skill_search: grepped SKILL.md + MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md + Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 for 'SDKTemplate', 'RootNamespace', 'x:Class', 'xmlns:local' — the only namespace handling is the Windows.UI.Xaml->Microsoft.UI.Xaml rewrite (script line 126); no root-namespace reconciliation anywhere.
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 only performs the Windows.UI.Xaml->Microsoft.UI.Xaml rewrite and never reconciles the app root namespace to the scaffold project namespace.
items.proposed_fix: Extend Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 (new step 3a): read the target project's RootNamespace, detect the dominant base namespace among copied .cs files, and if it differs, whole-word-rewrite that token to the project namespace across all copied .cs/.xaml (covers namespace decls, using, x:Class, xmlns:local, typeof). Report the count in the BOOTSTRAP COMPLETE block.
items.generalizes: Every UWP Windows-universal-sample (the dominant migration input) ships under the fixed 'SDKTemplate' root namespace, whereas 'dotnet new winui -n X' always scaffolds under 'X'. Reconciling them is a mechanical, every-scenario step; missing any one file yields WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType'/CS0246 errors.
